processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated through 'Amrah bint Abd al-Rahman: A man bought the fruit of a garden during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he worked on it and devoted himself to it until the loss became apparent to him. So he asked the owner of the garden to reduce the price for him or to cancel the transaction, but he swore not to do so. Then the mother of the buyer went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and mentioned that to him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'He swore not to do good.' When the owner of the garden heard about that, he came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, it is his.'

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated that 'Ata' ibn Yasar said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Dates for dates, like for like.' Then it was said to him: 'Indeed your agent over Khaybar takes one sa' for two sa'.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Call him to me.' So he was called to him, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: 'Do you take one sa' for two sa'?' He said: 'O Messenger of Allah, they do not sell me the good quality for the mixed quality, one sa' for one sa'.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: 'Sell the mixed quality for dirhams, then buy with the dirhams good quality.'

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri and Abu Hurayrah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ appointed a man over Khaybar, and he came to him with high-quality dates. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: 'Are all the dates of Khaybar like this?' He said: 'No, by Allah, O Messenger of Allah. Indeed we take one sa' of this for two sa', and two sa' for three.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Do not do that. Sell the mixed quality for dirhams, then buy with the dirhams high-quality.'

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated through Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade muzabanah and muhaqalah. And muzabanah is: buying fruit with dried dates. And muhaqalah is: buying crops for wheat, and renting land for wheat.
processed_hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي، عَنْ مَالِك، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ "نَهَى عَنِ الْمُزَابَنَةِ وَالْمُحَاقَلَةِ"

chainIssues: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab is a senior tabi'i who did not meet the Prophet ﷺ, making this a mursal narration

plainChains: Yahya -> Malik -> Ibn Shihab al-Zuhri -> Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab -> [Missing companion] -> Prophet Muhammad ﷺ

potential_issues.issue: Mursal hadith - Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab did not meet the Prophet ﷺ
potential_issues.impact: Significant - there is a missing companion in the chain. However, Sa'id's mursal reports are considered among the strongest mursal narrations by many scholars due to his reliability and precision.

potential_issues.issue: Ibn Shihab al-Zuhri uses 'an transmission term and is classified as a mudallis by some scholars
potential_issues.impact: Very minor - al-Zuhri is classified as category 2-3 mudallis by Ibn Hajar, but he is considered extremely reliable by the overwhelming majority of scholars. His tadlis does not significantly affect the grading when narrating from reliable narrators like Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab.
